title: Floareá Skies
summary: A 192-apartment tower in JVC with direct access to Al Khail Road and a rooftop infinity pool.
description: Floareá Skies is a 192-apartment tower in Jumeirah Village Circle with direct access to Al Khail Road. Homes run from 398 sq ft studios to two-bedroom apartments with a study, spread over 19 residential floors above four podium levels.

The amenities sit at the top and at podium level: an infinity pool on the roof, an organic pool for children, a Japanese garden with mini golf and a floating meditation deck. Payments follow a 30/70 plan, with 1% monthly and post-handover options.
features: 192 homes in a tower of four podium levels and 19 residential floors
Studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, several with a study

title: Floareá Oasis
summary: 257 homes in the Dubai Land Residence Complex, from studios to two-bedroom apartments, planned around family amenities.
description: Floareá Oasis is a 257-apartment building in the Dubai Land Residence Complex, with studios from 425 sq ft, one-bedroom apartments with a study and two-bedroom apartments with a maid's room, over 13 residential floors.

It is planned around families: a pool and splash pad, a children's play area, an outdoor gym and barbecue stations, with a fully equipped gym inside. Payments follow a 30/70 plan, with 1% monthly and post-handover options.

title: Floareá Breeze
summary: A boutique building of 48 apartments and 4 park-facing townhouses on Dubai Islands, a short walk from the beach.
description: Floareá Breeze is a boutique building on Dubai Islands with 48 apartments and 4 park-facing townhouses. Apartments have one to three bedrooms, from 878 sq ft; the three-bedroom townhouses run to about 1,900 sq ft.

The marina, the mall and the beach are about five minutes away on foot. The building has a pool and a children's pool, an indoor gym, a play area and a board game nook. Payments follow a 30/70 plan, with a post-handover option.

title: Floareá Grandé
summary: A 222-apartment building in Arjan, planned around a garden atrium with an olive tree at its centre.
description: Floareá Grandé is a 222-apartment building in Arjan, inside Dubai Properties' master community. Homes run from studios of about 422 sq ft to three-bedroom apartments of about 1,499 sq ft, on nine residential floors above a basement and ground floor.

The building is planned around a garden atrium with an olive tree at its centre. Seventeen amenities include a large pool, a children's pool, a gym, a steam room and sauna, and a clubhouse. It sits across from Floareá Residence, the developer's handed-over building in Arjan.

title: The Woods Abode
summary: One and two-bedroom apartments among the parks of Sobha Sanctuary in Dubailand, from 546 sq ft.
description: The Woods Abode is a block of 1 and 2 bedroom apartments inside The Woods, the apartment cluster of Sobha Sanctuary in Dubailand. Sobha lists four layouts, from a 546 sq ft one-bedroom to a 964 sq ft two-bedroom, each with a balcony. The listed starting price is AED 1.00M, and handover is shown as 2029.

The building sits among parkland, landscaped walkways and villa neighbourhoods within the wider Sobha Sanctuary masterplan, with a school close by according to the developer. Shared facilities include a pool deck, yoga and meditation areas, outdoor fitness zones, a co-working space, a library, a nursery and a children's play area themed around nature.

title: The Willows
summary: Four-bedroom villas in Sobha Sanctuary, a gated, low-density community built around parks and gardens.
description: The Willows is a group of four-bedroom villas in Sobha Sanctuary, a Sobha Realty masterplan in Dubailand. Four layouts are published, with saleable areas between about 2,459 and 3,430 sq ft; the two larger types add a maid's room and an upstairs living room. Listed prices run from AED 4.06M to AED 5.83M, and handover is shown as to be announced.

The cluster is planned around green space, with parks, a botanical garden, jogging and cycling loops, yoga and meditation areas, and an outdoor calisthenics zone. A mosque, a clubhouse, a pet zone and mobility hubs are also listed. The developer describes the community as gated and low-density.

title: Sobha Orbis
summary: Seven apartment towers in Motor City with one, one-and-a-half and two-bedroom homes, handover December 2027.
description: Sobha Orbis is a seven-tower apartment development by Sobha Realty in Motor City. It offers one, one-and-a-half and two-bedroom homes; the published floor plans run from about 538 sq ft for a one-bedroom to about 988 sq ft for a two-bedroom, and every layout has a balcony. Listed prices run from AED 1.57M to AED 2.81M.

Shared facilities include a resort-style pool, a jacuzzi, a barbecue area, a children's play area and ground-level retail. The developer lists First Avenue Mall, Dubai Autodrome and Dubai Studio City within a few minutes' drive, with Al Khail Road and Sheikh Zayed Road about 10 to 15 minutes away. Handover is listed as December 2027.

title: The Eden
summary: One and two-bedroom apartments in Sobha Central, a six-tower cluster by Jebel Ali Metro Station on Sheikh Zayed Road.
description: The Eden is an apartment tower in Sobha Central, a six-tower Sobha Realty cluster beside Sheikh Zayed Road near Jebel Ali Metro Station. It has one and two-bedroom apartments; the published plans run from about 568 sq ft to about 1,202 sq ft, all with balconies. Listed prices run from AED 1.83M to AED 3.54M, with handover listed as December 2029.

Residents reach the other towers and the shared podium through covered, connected lift lobbies. The developer lists a shopping mall, a multiplex cinema, a gym, a prayer hall, a medical clinic and a supermarket in the cluster, and the brochure mentions 175,000 sq ft of office space. The tower's own facilities include a leisure pool, an outdoor gym and an outdoor cinema.

title: Skyvue Stellar
summary: The tallest of the Skyvue towers in Sobha Hartland II, with one to three-and-a-half-bedroom apartments facing the lagoon.
description: Skyvue Stellar is an apartment tower in the Skyvue group at Sobha Hartland II, the Sobha Realty community in Mohammed Bin Rashid City. The published plans range from a one-bedroom of about 626 sq ft to three and three-and-a-half-bedroom units of about 1,600 to 1,681 sq ft. Listed prices run from AED 2.38M to AED 8.96M, with handover listed as March 2029.

The tower faces the community lagoon and looks toward the Downtown Dubai skyline. Facilities include a leisure pool and an infinity pool, an indoor gym, an indoor cinema, a jogging loop, a skate park, an art and music room, and a library. Sobha lists Downtown Dubai and Business Bay within about 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Sobha Elwood
summary: Four to six-bedroom villas in a 10 million sq ft community off Dubai–Al Ain Road, almost half of it parkland.
description: Sobha Elwood is a villa community by Sobha Realty in Al Yufrah, off Dubai–Al Ain Road, covering about 10 million sq ft. It offers four, five and six-bedroom villas; published saleable areas run from about 4,958 sq ft to 7,186 sq ft, and every published type includes a maid's room. Listed prices run from AED 9.92M to AED 14.39M, with handover listed as June 2027.

The developer states that 47% of the land is open space and parks, planted with more than 10,000 trees, and that the parks are themed on forests such as the Amazon and baobab woodlands. Listed facilities include a clubhouse, a cycling track, a cricket pitch, a dog park, a community garden and a treehouse.

title: DAMAC Islands 2
summary: Townhouses and villas around lagoons and waterways in DAMAC Islands 2, Dubailand, from four bedrooms.
description: DAMAC Islands 2 is the second island-themed villa community from DAMAC in Dubailand. Its clusters take their names from eight tropical islands, and the homes sit around lagoons, waterways and planted parks. The developer lists the master community at 20 million square feet.

The brochure covers three home types: 4- and 5-bedroom townhouses, 5-bedroom twin villas and 6-bedroom detached villas, several with a maid's room. The smallest published plan is 2,185.50 sq ft. The project page currently lists 4- and 5-bedroom homes as available.

title: Chelsea Residences
summary: Waterfront apartments in Dubai Maritime City, developed with Chelsea Football Club, with a rooftop football pitch.
description: Chelsea Residences is a waterfront apartment scheme in Dubai Maritime City, developed by DAMAC in partnership with Chelsea Football Club. The brochure shows six towers split into two phases. Heights range from 25 to 33 floors above a ground level and two podium floors, and the developer counts more than 1,400 homes.

Apartments have one, two or three bedrooms. The podium and roof carry football-themed facilities, including a rooftop pitch, a simulation room and a training gym, plus pools, a spa and a children's play area. The project page currently lists 1- and 2-bedroom units for sale.

title: Azure 2 at DAMAC Riverside Views
summary: One and two-bedroom apartments along the water channels of DAMAC Riverside, handover Q1 2029.
description: Azure 2 is an apartment cluster within DAMAC Riverside Views, part of the DAMAC Riverside community that the site places in Dubai Investment Park. Mid-rise buildings line a man-made river and water channels, and residents share landscaped walkways and open space between the blocks.

The project offers 1- and 2-bedroom apartments; the unit cards show maximum sizes of 1,050 and 1,504 sq ft. Listed facilities include a beach-style lagoon, water-based sports, outdoor fitness stations, cooking stations and a children's play area. The page gives handover as Q1 2029.

title: Violet 4
summary: Four-bedroom townhouses with gardens and roof terraces in DAMAC Hills 2.
description: Violet 4 is a cluster of 4-bedroom townhouses in DAMAC Hills 2, a large master community by the same developer in Dubailand. There are two layouts, an end unit and a middle unit. Each has ground, first and roof floors, a private garden and a roof terrace.

The brochure gives total saleable areas of 2,352.26 sq ft for the middle unit and 2,415.33 sq ft for the end unit. Residents use the wider community's facilities, including a wave pool, a lazy river, sports fields, a zen garden and an open-air cinema.

title: Valencia at DAMAC Lagoons District
summary: Studios, one and two-bedroom apartments in the mixed-use district of DAMAC Lagoons, beside offices and a mall.
description: Valencia is the residential part of DAMAC Lagoons District, a mixed-use area inside the DAMAC Lagoons master community in Dubailand. The district combines apartment buildings with the Piazza Roma office towers and a mall with shops and restaurants, all linked by walkways.

The brochure covers studios, 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments. The project page currently lists 1- and 2-bedroom units. Shared facilities include a pool bar, a gym, a spa, a lounge, an outdoor theatre and shaded walkways with misting. The developer publishes a 60/40 payment plan.
features: Apartment component of DAMAC Lagoons District, a mixed-use zone that also includes the Piazza Roma office towers and a mall

title: Couture by Cavalli
summary: 95 homes with Roberto Cavalli interiors on the Dubai Canal beside Safa Park, each with its own pool.
description: Couture by Cavalli is a residential tower on the Dubai Canal beside Safa Park, with interiors branded by the Italian fashion house Roberto Cavalli. The brochure caps the building at 95 homes over 16 residential levels, with 3- to 5-bedroom apartments and 6-bedroom penthouses on the upper floors.

According to the brochure, each home has its own infinity pool and terrace garden, and the penthouses have private sky gardens. The podium holds a lagoon-style pool, a gym and spa, a cigar lounge and club rooms. Unit cards currently show 3-, 4- and 5-bedroom apartments of up to 7,711 sq ft.

summary: Vida-branded one to three-bedroom apartments in Dubai Creek Harbour, beside parkland.
description: Montiva is a Vida-branded apartment building in Dubai Creek Harbour, Emaar's waterfront district beside the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. It offers one to three-bedroom homes, and Emaar describes views over parkland and the neighbouring golf course from the units.

Shared facilities centre on an infinity pool, a children's splash area and planted gardens, with sports courts, a running track and retail along the community promenade. On 16 September 2026 Emaar's page listed nine available units from 755 to 1,246 sq ft. It gives no handover date or payment plan.

summary: Palace-branded apartments and three-bedroom townhouses in Dubai Hills Estate, close to Dubai Hills Park.

Emaar describes the grounds as resort-style, with pools, dining and wellness spaces.

title: Ovelle
summary: Four and five-bedroom detached villas in The Valley, Emaar's community off the Al Ain Road.
description: Ovelle is a villa neighbourhood within The Valley, Emaar's community in the Ud Al Bayda area on the Dubai side of the Al Ain Road. It is made up of four and five-bedroom detached villas, with interiors in earthy tones and large glazed openings.

Shared spaces include a landscaped pool deck, a gym, an indoor multipurpose room, a children's playground and a pet park, with Terrace Trails and Central Park inside the community. On 16 September 2026 Emaar listed six available villas from 5,670 to 7,970 sq ft.

summary: Three to five-bedroom villas in The Heights Country Club & Wellness, a community built around a wellness lake.
description: Salva is a villa release in The Heights Country Club & Wellness, a master community Emaar unveiled in May 2024 and describes as 10 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. The villas have three to five bedrooms and white contemporary exteriors with covered parking.

The community is organised around health and outdoor activity: a wellness centre, a lake with a promenade, a yoga lake, a meditation garden and a private beach. On 16 September 2026 Emaar listed 15 available villas from 3,340 to 5,884 sq ft.

title: Palm Central Private Residences
summary: Apartments and townhouses in three low to mid-rise buildings at the centre of Palm Jebel Ali, with beach access.
description: Palm Central Private Residences is a Nakheel apartment and townhouse project on Palm Jebel Ali, spread over three low to mid-rise buildings in the middle of the island. Nakheel first released it in October 2025 and added a 222-home phase in June 2026.

Homes range from one-bedroom apartments to townhouses. Nakheel's price sheet starts at AED 2.7 million for a one-bedroom and gives an estimated construction completion of September 2030. Facilities include an infinity pool, padel and volleyball courts, a fitness studio, a clubhouse and children's play areas.

title: Everly Place
summary: 209 apartments in a mid-rise building around the crystal lagoon of Meydan Horizon, Mohammed Bin Rashid City.
description: Everly Place is a mid-rise residential building by Ellington Properties in Meydan Horizon, part of Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Its U-shaped plan wraps around the crystal lagoon, and the developer lists 209 homes: one- and two-bedroom apartments, and one- to three-bedroom layouts that include a study. Launch was announced in June 2026.

Shared facilities sit on a landscaped podium and include a 23-metre infinity-edge pool, a club lounge with a bowling alley, a fitness studio, a yoga room and changing rooms with sauna. Interiors use engineered stone kitchens with European appliances and 3.1-metre ceilings. Ellington has not published prices, unit sizes or a completion date on its website.

title: The Meriva Collection
summary: Beachfront apartments, penthouses and signature residences on Island B of Dubai Islands.
description: The Meriva Collection is a beachfront development by Ellington Properties on Island B of Dubai Islands. It combines five residential buildings, one signature beachfront residence and a hotel run by a third-party operator, all with access to the beach. Homes range from one- to four-bedroom apartments and penthouses, many with study rooms.

A small number of three- and five-bedroom signature residences have private pools and a rooftop gym. The masterplan adds indoor and outdoor pools, a 2 km jogging track, sports courts, a jazz club, coworking space and cafes. Ellington announced the launch in February 2026 but does not publish prices, unit sizes or a handover date on its website.

title: Binghatti Etherea
summary: 282 studios, one and two-bedroom apartments in JVC, handover July 2027.
description: Binghatti Etherea is a residential tower in Jumeirah Village Circle with 282 apartments and five shops at ground level. The building rises over a basement, ground floor and five podium levels to 22 residential floors. Homes are studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, with published sizes starting at 336 sq ft for a studio.

Shared facilities are grouped on a fifth-floor deck with adult and children's pools, a jacuzzi, a play area and an exercise platform. Binghatti gives the handover as July 2027 and lists a plan of 20% at booking, 50% during construction and 30% on completion. The site lists studios from AED 767,999.

title: Binghatti Skyblade
summary: A 55-floor tower on Burj Khalifa Boulevard with 619 homes and a rooftop pool facing the Burj Khalifa.
description: Binghatti Skyblade is a high-rise on Burj Khalifa Boulevard in Downtown Dubai, with views toward the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Water Canal. The project facts list 619 homes: 188 studios, 208 premium studios, 100 one-bedroom Royal Suites, 110 two-bedroom apartments, 10 two-bedroom suites and 3 three-bedroom units, plus two shops.

The tower has four basement levels, three podium floors and 55 residential floors topped by a lit crown. Facilities include a rooftop infinity pool, a gym, a running track, a spa and private pools for the sky terrace apartments. Binghatti gives completion as Q4 2027 and lists studios from AED 1,764,999 for 386 sq ft.

title: BAYZ 102
summary: A 102-storey tower of furnished apartments and penthouses in Business Bay, sold on Danube's 2% monthly plan.
description: BAYZ 102 is a 102-level apartment tower by Danube Properties on Al Mustaqbal Street in Business Bay, a short walk from the Business Bay Metro station and near Sheikh Zayed Road. It sits on the same street as the developer's BAYZ 101 and was announced in September 2024. The upper floors look toward the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Canal.

The tower offers studios, one- to four-bedroom apartments and penthouses, all handed over furnished with Dolce Vita Italian furniture, and some units include a private pool. Danube lists more than 40 shared facilities, among them a canal-view infinity pool, an aquatic gym, a spa, sports courts and an outdoor cinema, as well as a helipad intended for sky taxis.
